import re, difflib
d = open('/app/sequences.fasta').read()
recs = re.findall(r'>(\S+)\n([a-z\s]+)', d)
seqs = {n: ''.join(s.split()) for n, s in recs}
S = seqs['input']; T = seqs['output']
print('len input:', len(S), 'len output:', len(T))

# prefix/suffix identity
i = 0
while i < min(len(S), len(T)) and S[i] == T[i]: i += 1
j = 0
while j < min(len(S), len(T)) and S[len(S)-1-j] == T[len(T)-1-j]: j += 1
print('prefix match:', i, 'suffix match:', j)

sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, S, T, autojunk=False)
print('similarity ratio:', sm.ratio())
blocks = sm.get_matching_blocks()
prev_i = prev_j = 0
diffs = []
for b in blocks:
    if b.a - prev_i > 0 or b.b - prev_j > 0:
        diffs.append((prev_i, b.a, prev_j, b.b))
    prev_i, prev_j = b.a + b.size, b.b + b.size
print('num diff regions:', len(diffs))
for (a0, a1, b0, b1) in diffs:
    print(f'--- diff: input[{a0}:{a1}] len={a1-a0}  output[{b0}:{b1}] len={b1-b0}')

    print('  out:', T[b0:b1])

    print('  context out:', T[max(0,b0-40):b0], '||', T[b1:b1+40])
